# Meteor Dash

A minimalist HTML canvas game where the player controls a ship moving horizontally at the bottom while meteors fall from the top. The ship must avoid collisions; touching a meteor ends the game.

1: // Minimal Meteor Dash game targeting canvas with id="game"
2: // Ship moves horizontally at bottom, meteors fall from top.
3: // Collision ends the game.
4: 
5: (() => {
6:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
7:   if (!canvas) return; // canvas not found
8:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
9:   // Set canvas size (you may adjust as needed)
10:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth || 800;
11:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight || 600;
12: 
13:   // Audio setup
14:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
15:   // Resume audio on first interaction
16:   window.addEventListener('keydown', () => {
17:     if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume();
18:   });
19:   function playTone(freq, type = 'sine', duration = 0.2) {
20:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
21:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
22:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
23:     osc.type = type;
24:     osc.connect(gain);
25:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
26:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, audioCtx.currentTime);
27:     osc.start();
28:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
29:   }
30: 
31:   // Generate background stars once
32:   const stars = [];
33:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
34:     stars.push({
35:       x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
36:       y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
37:       radius: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
38:     });
39:   }
40: 
41:   const ship = {
42:     width: 40,
43:     height: 20,
44:     x: canvas.width / 2 - 20,
45:     y: canvas.height - 30,
46:     speed: 5,
47:   };
48: 
49:   const meteors = [];
50:   const meteorSize = 30;
51:   const meteorSpeed = 2;
52:   const spawnInterval = 1000; // ms
53:   let lastSpawn = 0;
54:   let gameOver = false;
55: 
56:   const keys = { ArrowLeft: false, ArrowRight: false };
57: 
58:   function update(dt) {
59:     if (gameOver) return;
60:     // Move ship
61:     if (keys.ArrowLeft) ship.x -= ship.speed;
62:     if (keys.ArrowRight) ship.x += ship.speed;
63:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(canvas.width - ship.width, ship.x));
64: 
65:     // Spawn meteors
66:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > spawnInterval) {
67:       meteors.push({
68:         x: Math.random() * (canvas.width - meteorSize),
69:         y: -meteorSize,
70:         size: meteorSize,
71:       });
72:       playTone(500, 'square', 0.1); // meteor spawn sound
73:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
74:     }
75: 
76:     // Update meteors
77:     for (let i = meteors.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
78:       const m = meteors[i];
79:       m.y += meteorSpeed;
80:       // Remove off‑screen meteors
81:       if (m.y > canvas.height) meteors.splice(i, 1);
82:       // Collision detection (AABB)
83:       if (
84:         ship.x < m.x + m.size &&
85:         ship.x + ship.width > m.x &&
86:         ship.y < m.y + m.size &&
87:         ship.y + ship.height > m.y
88:       ) {
89:           gameOver = true;
90:           playTone(200, 'sawtooth', 0.5); // collision sound
91:         }
92:     }
93:   }
94: 
95: function draw() {
96:     // Slight motion blur background
97:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2)';
98:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
99:     // Draw star field
100:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
101:     stars.forEach(star => {
102:       ctx.beginPath();
103:       ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, star.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
104:       ctx.fill();
105:     });
106:     // Draw ship as gradient triangle
107:     const shipGradient = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, ship.y, 0, ship.y + ship.height);
108:     shipGradient.addColorStop(0, '#0f0');
109:     shipGradient.addColorStop(1, '#050');
110:     ctx.fillStyle = shipGradient;
111:     ctx.beginPath();
112:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.height);
113:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.width / 2, ship.y);
114:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.width, ship.y + ship.height);
115:     ctx.closePath();
116:     ctx.fill();
117:     // Draw meteors with radial gradient
118:     meteors.forEach(m => {
119:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(
120:         m.x + m.size / 2,
121:         m.y + m.size / 2,
122:         m.size * 0.1,
123:         m.x + m.size / 2,
124:         m.y + m.size / 2,
125:         m.size / 2
126:       );
127:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#ff4444');
128:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#880000');
129:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
130:       ctx.beginPath();
131:       ctx.arc(m.x + m.size / 2, m.y + m.size / 2, m.size / 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
132:       ctx.fill();
133:     });
134:     // Game over overlay
135:     if (gameOver) {
136:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.5)';
137:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
138:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
139:       ctx.font = '48px sans-serif';
140:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
141:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
142:     }
143: 
144: 
145:   let lastTime = 0;
146:   function loop(timestamp) {
147:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
148:     lastTime = timestamp;
149:     update(dt);
150:     draw();
151:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
152:   }
153: 
154:   // Input handlers
155:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
156:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
157:       keys[e.key] = true;
158:     }
159:   });
160:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => {
161:     if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
162:       keys[e.key] = false;
163:     }
164:   });
165: 
166:   requestAnimationFrame(loop);
167: })();
